newsitem.title: USA: Corestaff says buys Metamor Technologies.
newsitem.headline: Corestaff says buys Metamor Technologies.

text.p: Corestaff Inc said Thursday it bought the Chicago-based systems integration company Metamor Technologies Ltd for an undisclosed sum.
Metamor, with offices in Chicago and Nashville, Tenn., is projected to have gross revenues of more than $30 million for fiscal year 1997, Corestaff said.
Corestaff did not say how much the acquisition would add to its earnings. Officials there were not immediately available to comment further.
Since January 1, Corestaff said it has announced the acquisition or proposed acquisition of three companies with projected 1997 gross revenues of about $100 million.
